title: Success Chime
blurb: A bright ascending major-chord chime that means it worked. Task complete, payment accepted, answer correct — this is the sound of small victories. Use it for stream channel-point wins, quiz-night right answers, or ironically after doing the bare minimum. It's the optimistic sibling of the wrong-answer buzzer, and they work beautifully as a pair. Original synthesis, free to use.
origin: Original C-major arpeggio synthesis in the style of app success sounds.
